rows.meaning: act or state of being restricted
rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a restriction, whether it means the state of being restricted or a limiting rule.

example.english: This policy places too much restriction on small businesses.
example.traditional: 呢個政策對小商戶嘅限制太多喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 deoi3 siu2 soeng1 wu6 ge3 haan6 zai3 taai3 do1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the restriction is specifically an explicit rule or regulation rather than a general limitation.

example.english: There is a restriction on bringing outside food into the venue.
example.traditional: 入場有規定，唔准帶外來食物。
example.jyutping: jap6 coeng4 jau5 kwai1 ding6 m4 zeon2 daai2 ngoi6 loi4 sik6 mat6
